title: Kenya Gen Z Protests Tracker Update — Aug 23, 2026
summary: Activist Julius Kamau chained himself to the gates of Jogoo House, national police headquarters, on August 17 as six protesters demanding Inspector General Douglas Kanja's resignation were arrested. A day later, former Chief Justice David Maraga gave President Ruto a seven-day ultimatum — deadline August 25 — to release the long-shelved National Taskforce on Police Reforms report, accusing the government of 'State Capture of the National Police Service.' Both developments keep police accountability, a core Gen Z movement demand, in the public eye even as large-scale street protests remain paused since the June 2026 anniversary.
